articleTitle: Comparison of Performance of YASA Axial Flux Permanent Magnet Motor with Interior Tangential Rotor and Sticker Rotor
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: To study whether the yokeless and segmented armature axial-flux interior permanent-magnet (YASA-AF-IPM) has more advantages in electromagnetic performance than the traditional the yokeless and segmented armature axial-flux permanent-magnet (YASA-AFPM) when applied to electric vehicles, the structure and characteristics of two kinds of motors with different topologies were analyzed, and the YASA-AF-IPM and YASA-AFPM motor were designed respectively by finite element method. The operation performance of two kinds of motors with different topologies is compared and analyzed in the aspects of no-load back electromotive force, rated torque, torque ripple, eddy current loss of permanent magnet, and anti-demagnetization ability of permanent magnet. The results show that the YASA-AF-IPM motor has good performance and certain advantages. It can be used as one of the strong competitors for electric vehicle generator design.

articleTitle: An Intrusion Detection Method for CBTC Systems Using Blockchain and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: One of the key information security issues of CBTC systems is the data accessibility and reliability. The traditional information security methods cannot deal with data accessibility, reliability and intrusion detection problems simultaneously. In this paper, an intrusion detection method is proposed using blockchain and LSTM for CBTC systems. This method combines the advantages of distributed data sharing of blockchain, and the characteristics of high detection accuracy of LSTM neural network. The parameters of the LSTM neural network model and the hash value of the detection alerts are encapsulated as transactions and uploaded to the blockchain, all the transactions can be shared and confirmed by the blockchain nodes. Simulations are carried out with real CBTC data and the results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.

articleTitle: A Customized Kubernetes Scheduling Algorithm to Improve Resource Utilization of Nodes
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This article proposes a customized Kubernetes scheduling algorithm to improve resource utilization of nodes in a cluster. The algorithm is optimized over the default algorithm. The custom algorithm solves two problems, that are setting an appropriate Request value and determining the scoring rule. The article also evaluates the performance of the custom algorithm. It can be seen that the utilization rate of node resources is improved, and load balance between nodes in the cluster is better.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Convolutional Neural Network Based on YOLO Algorithm in Pest Small Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In agricultural science, preventing and controlling diseases and insect pests is a key research topic. Information technology has been applied to pest detection and identification. In crop pest research, neural networks can improve accuracy and efficiency by applying image recognition and classification technology. The small size of the pests in the disease pictures makes them easy to detect. The pest small target data set is constructed in this paper to train small target detection networks. A convolutional neural network based on the YOLO algorithm was proposed to detect small targets, such as pests, with few features. This paper also proposes a mosaic-based data enhancement method, label smoothing processing, and a backbone network improvement idea to improve the detection efficiency of the YOLOv5 model.

articleTitle: Application of Decision Tree Algorithm in Medical Nursing and Health Assessment System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In the rapid development of information construction of medical system, more and more work depends on information. Data mining can extract useful information hidden behind a large amount of information, so it is used more and more widely in hospital information construction. Decision tree classification is an important method in data mining. Decision tree mining technology is applied to medical and nursing and health data to analyze and mine the factors affecting medical and nursing staff’s medical nursing and health. The medical nursing and health of medical staff is an important factor affecting their lives, work and safety. In recent years, they have received widespread attention at home and abroad. Therefore, it is urgent to evaluate the medical staff and provide health and psychological interventions to support this group. This paper studies the application of decision tree algorithm in the medical and nursing psychological personality health evaluation system, and understands the relevant theoretical knowledge of psychological evaluation on the basis of literature data, and then designs the medical nursing and health evaluation system based on the decision tree algorithm. The decision tree algorithm cited in the system is tested, and the test results show that after the improved algorithm in this paper is added with a balance coefficient of 0<λ≤1, the distance distance between the attribute and the root node has been shortened to varying degrees.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Test Paper Generation System for Online Psychological Testing Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In the calculation process of ant colony algorithm, the ant colony transfer is guided by the pheromone intensity and distance of each path, and the path of ant colony movement always tends to the path with the strongest information. Due to the influence of pheromone concentration, the subsequent ants have a higher probability of choosing a shorter path, thus forming a positive feedback mechanism, and eventually the entire ant colony will find an optimal path to find food sources. Intelligent paper grouping problem is actually a process of combinatorial optimization of the target according to the given constraints, so as to obtain the best solution. The traditional psychological test has many problems such as single test question, low test frequency and disclosure of personal privacy, so the results of psychological test are often not authentic. The network psychological test database is constructed, and the paper is automatically assembled based on ant colony algorithm. The convergence speed is fast, the robustness is outstanding, and it is convenient to realize the global algorithm.

articleTitle: Particle swarm optimization LSTM based stock prediction model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Due to the high stochasticity and complexity of stock forecasting, the and forecasting ability of a single model is limited. In order to accurately analyze and predict the impact of stock price changes over time, a PSO-LSTM stock forecasting model is put forward. The model is improved and optimized on the basis of LSTM model. Particle swarm optimization algorithm can optimize the key parameters of LSTM model and make stock prediction more accurate. It is therefore good at dealing with complex non-linear problems with long-term dependencies. Experiments were conducted to construct the PSO-LSTM model with Shenzhen Ping An stock data respectively, and the forecasting effects on the model were compared with other forecasting models to do an analysis. The results show that the PSO-LSTM stock price forecasting model not only improves the forecasting accuracy but also has general applicability.

articleTitle: Air quality secondary forecast model based on ARIMA time series model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the further frequent of human living activities, natural meteorological changes will lead to some harmful substances into the atmosphere, the concentration of harmful substances is too high will harm people's health, air quality forecast can make people timely and effective response to bad air conditions In this paper, the concentrations of six common pollutants related to air quality are analyzed and predicted by combining existing air quality forecasting models and known data. The time series model is established and the secondary model is built on the basis of the original primary forecast, which improves the accuracy of air quality forecast.

articleTitle: Improved K-means Hyperspectral Image Classification Algorithm Based on Variance Coefficient Weighting
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the number of hyperspectral image bands is huge and it is easy to cause "dimension disaster," an improved K-means hyperspectral classification algorithm based on variance coefficient weighting is proposed. The algorithm is based on the traditional K-means algorithm, it portray the importance of bands by introducing variance coefficients and express intra-class correlation using correlation coefficients. Finally, it incorporates inter-class information to achieve global optimal clustering. The algorithm in this paper compensates for the shortcomings of the K-means algorithm in viewing each feature equally, while taking into account intra-class and inter-class information, which enhances the accuracy of hyperspectral image classification to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Abnormal Detection of Rolling Bearing Based on Multidimensional Feature Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Bearing abnormal detection is extremely important in supporting maintenance decisions and guaranteeing the system’s reliability. Vibration-based time and frequency domain statistical features are wildly utilized to characterize the rolling bearing lifetime state. However, the facts that no general consensus has been reached as to which statistical features are sensitive for bearing lifetime performance degradation and that there are co-dependent relations among features (i.e., the horizontal correlation between the former feature values and the latter one in time-dependent sequences, and the vertical correlation between multiple different features) motivated this investigation of the method to fuse multidimensional time and frequency domain features into deep learning model for abnormal detection. In this paper, convolutional neural networks (CNN) are used to capture the horizontal correlation between multidimensional feature vectors, gated recurrent unit (GRU) to obtain the vertical correlation on time series, and linear layer to fuse the horizontal and vertical dependencies of multidimensional feature vectors. The effectiveness and high dependability of the suggested strategy are validated by experimental findings on the bearing run-to-failure dataset.

articleTitle: Navigation control of mobile robot based on fuzzy neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Aiming at the current problem of mobile robot navigation control accuracy, this paper proposes a control method based on fuzzy neural networks and PID. The image processing algorithm extracts the navigation line and calculates the robot position by using RTK-GPS/UWB after obtaining the visual information. A navigation controller based on a fuzzy neural network is designed to generate the target heading angle, calculated by the lower computer combined with the motion model. A PID-based controller is designed to control walking and steering. The deviation is calculated to adjust the position of the robot to further improve the navigation accuracy. This method is verified in a simulated farmland environment. The experiments show that the position calculation results are consistent with the measured results. The proposed method can improve the control accuracy of the robot. The whole navigation system has high real-time performance and can meet actual needs.

articleTitle: A Novel Efficient Deep Unfolding Algorithm Based on WMMSE for Downlink Beamforming
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Downlink beamforming has received great attention in wireless communications. Although the popular weighted minimum mean square error (WMMSE) algorithm can provide excellent performance, it exhibits prohibitively computational complexity. To address this problem, based on the structure of WMMSE algorithm, we propose an efficient ahead momentum-based deep unfolding neural network (AMDUNN) algorithm. Simulation results verify that the proposed AMDUNN remarkably outperforms the existing deep unfolding algorithms with lower complexity.

articleTitle: Communication Anti-jamming Strategy Engine Based on Cuckoo Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In this article, a communication anti-jamming strategy engine based on cuckoo search algorithm is proposed to solve the problem of communication anti-jamming decision after receiving interference in wireless ad hoc networks. The algorithm can be initialized by using the solution of the previous decision, so as to obtain the anti-jamming strategy faster, determine the transmission power and channel selection faster, and reduce the amount of calculation. The simulation results show that the algorithm can improve the convergence speed of the cuckoo algorithm in the interference environment without increasing the complexity, and has better real-time performance, which is more in line with the application scenarios of communication anti-interference.

articleTitle: Load Balancing Algorithm of SDN Controller Based on Dynamic Threshold
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of unbalanced control plane load in software defined network(SDN), a controller load balancing algorithm based on dynamic threshold(CLBDT) is proposed, which adjusts the controller load through the designed dynamic variable threshold adjustment mechanism, and migrates switches under heavily loaded controllers to other lightly loaded controllers, so as to adapt to the dynamically changing and uneven network traffic and complete the load balance of the control plane. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme is superior to relevant algorithms in improving the load balancing of distributed controllers and contributes to improving network performance.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Convolutional Neural Network Based on the YOLO Algorithm in Airport Intelligent Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the technological development of civil aviation, the intelligent monitoring system based on security monitoring has gradually become a risk prevention and control mechanism in the daily operation of civil aviation. As the first line of defense for aviation safety, the airport has deployed a high-definition video surveillance system covering the entire area. However, the vast number of security surveillance videos makes it almost impossible to complete the monitoring and real-time tracking by manpower alone. In this context, the use of machine learning methods to identify risky clues in security surveillance videos and provide real-time early warnings has become the core implementation of intelligent airport surveillance. This paper discusses a smart monitoring system for airport security monitoring scenarios, designs the basic structure of the system, and builds a method for extracting and identifying potential illegal targets based on the YOLO algorithm. The research in this paper provides a basic technical framework for the airport intelligent monitoring platform and adequate technical support for the intelligent work of airport security.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Various FEC-coded OFDM Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) is used to encode digital data at multiple carrier frequencies and has evolved into a very common broadband digital communication scheme. All its subcarriers are orthogonal to each other, reducing the interference among subcarriers. Additionally, inter-symbol interference (ISI) can be reduced by using the Cyclic Prefix (CP). However, the intra-block OFDM symbol still degrades the performance. Bit Error Rate (BER) can be used to analyze OFDM performance. The efficiency of the OFDM system increases as the BER value decreases. The performance of the errors can be enhanced by using forward error correction. This study covers the performance of OFDM with Linear Block Code, Convolutional Code, Cyclic Block Code, Turbo Code, and LDPC across the whole SNR range. There has also been a discussion of the difference between coded and uncoded OFDM. The outcome demonstrates that Cyclic Block Code is superior to Linear Block Code in complex situations., LDPC Code performs better when increasing the data rate than Convolutional Code, and with more code generator polynomials, Turbo Code shows less BER value in comparison with Convolutional Code.

articleTitle: Feature Ratio Method: A Payload Feature Extraction and Detection Approach for SQL Injection Attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Due to the complexity of the deployment environment and the differences in the syntax of the backend database engine, SQL injection attacks have the characteristics of high complexity and poor timeliness. In recent years, the ability to detect and predict SQL injection attacks based on machine learning has been widely recognized in preventing unknown network security risks. However, most of these studies use the method in text classification to extract features of SQL injection attack payloads. The SQL injection attack payload is different from ordinary natural language, so there are problems with inaccurate segmentation and large vocabulary in the conventional feature extraction methods. This paper proposes a feature ratio method for feature extraction and detection of SQL injection attack payloads and compares it with various machine learning algorithms. The experimental results show that the average F1 Score of this method reaches 96.29%, which is better than the methods of the previous studies in terms of accuracy and precision. It shows that our method can better help machine learning algorithms to classify and detect SQL injection attack payloads.

articleTitle: A Research on Modulation and Detection in OFDM-IM System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the rapid development of the information industry, the amount of data for communications is growing, and people are demanding communication of higher performance and faster speed. The index modulation (M) technique attracts great attention from scholars due to its high spectral and energy efficiency. Recently, a new technique for implementing index modulation using orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) subcarriers has been proposed. This technique is called OFDM with index modulation (OFDM-IM). Instead of activating all subcarriers, OFDM-IM technology selectively activates a portion of subcarriers to transmit modulation symbols. This paper first briefly introduces the OFDM - IM system. Then, the BER and BER performance of OFDM-IM under different 5G mainstream modulation modes and different detection, such as ML and LLR, are studied. Finally, the OFDM-IM system performance with (7, 4) hamming code is studied. Compared to the classical OFDM system, the OFDM-IM system can improve performance.

articleTitle: Multithreading Technology Based on Golang Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper deeply analyzes the application of multithreading in the current emerging programming language, Go language, from the example of "personal warehouse management system". It describes the overall design of the Go language system and discusses the basic concept of multithreading. Besides, by comparing the test data in the examples to illustrate the significance of using multithreading technology for optimization under the environment of Go language.

articleTitle: wAdvMTD: A Mitigation to White-box Adversarial Examples Using Heterogeneous Models and Moving Target Defense
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In recent years, the adversarial example has become a non-trivial threat to the deep learning model. It harms the availability and integrity of deep learning as the inconspicuous perturbation is hard to be distinguished by a human observer. Among the mitigation strategies, those schemes using moving target defense as the methodology to defend adversarial examples proclaims a satisfactory performance in the black-box context. As for protecting deep learning models from white-box adversaries, however, only scheduling a model from the candidate set randomly to handle these stronger adversaries seems insufficient. Furthermore, the mitigation is vulnerable if the scheduling process is exposed to the adversary. In this paper, we proposed a white-box adversarial examples mitigation mechanism called wAdvMTD. It can automatically diversify the model structure of deep neural networks to make the attack vector to a certain model fails on the rest of its heterogeneous models. We make a proof-of-concept by deploying this mechanism to ResNet. Compared with the methodology that only schedules one of the pre-built models, using a set of structure-diversified models can reach a higher accuracy even with the constraint that this mechanism is completely exposed to the adversary.

articleTitle: OFDM communication system based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The technique known as orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) is crucial to wireless communication. Its efficient modulation, more efficient spectrum utilization due to carrier orthogonality, interference immunity due to broadband, and strong multipath resistance make it widely used in many communication standards, such as wireless local area networks (WLAN). As a logic device, FPGAs can support the application and verification of OFDM technology. Also, as FPGA devices evolve, their ability to process information is getting stronger due to their high degree of parallelism. Its operation speed is also relatively fast, ensuring the system's real-time performance. In this paper, OFDM technology based on FPGA chips will be discussed comprehensively, and examples will be given where appropriate. FPGA-based OFDM system is very promising, it can not only play a role in phase compensation in the 5G field, but also can ensure the reliable security of information transmission with digital chaos in information security, and can also achieve timing synchronization in repeated structured sequences, which has broad prospects in future life and technology.

articleTitle: Research and design of a multi-type common item recognition system based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: At present, artificial intelligence and Internet of Things technology has developed very rapidly, and the use of various types of robots and robotic arms has been rapidly popularized. In this case, the market has gradually put forward new requirements for the motion control and visual recognition ability of robots. Based on this current situation, this paper designs a multi-type common object recognition system based on YOLOv5 neural network model, and optimizes the recognition process of the neural network model based on the dynamic mask method for practical application scenarios. The recognition accuracy of the system is improved. The system designed in this paper includes software process design, hardware architecture design and test platform UI design. The tests show that the recognition system designed in this paper requires small hardware computing power, is easy to build, and the recognition accuracy and recognition speed can meet the actual application requirements. At the same time, the test platform can be optimized for different scenarios, which can lay a certain foundation for the subsequent system optimization and other researches.

articleTitle: Breaking the Trust Circle in HarmonyOS by Chaining Multiple Vulnerabilities
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Huawei's 1+8+N strategy is a popular solution for the Internet of Everything. With the introduction of its trust circle authentication mechanism, the security of device- to-device communication is guaranteed to some degree. Despite many security measures adopted in the protocols related to the trust circle service, we still find 0day vulnerabilities. In this work, we conduct a thorough security analysis of the implementation and workflow of Huawei's trust circle service. As a result, we find four 0day vulnerabilities in each of its stages and propose an exploit chain to bypass the "same account" check in the latest HarmonyOS at that time. These vulnerabilities are reported to the vendors, acknowledged and fixed by them in their subsequent releases.

articleTitle: Research on Accurate Inspection Technology of Smart Grid Electric Energy Meter Based on Computer Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper analyzes the inspection error of the traditional electric energy meter constant inspection method. It is believed that the inspection error of the electric energy meter constant is mainly caused by the manual control pulse when the inspector carries out the last digit of the liquid crystal meter of the electric energy meter during the constant inspection. The time difference between the start and stop of the counter is not synchronized and the truncation error of the pulse counter recorded pulse. Based on the establishment of a smart energy meter image detection system with C# and Halcon as the software platform, the Blob analysis algorithm is used to extract the ROI (region of interest) from the image, and the histogram equalization is used to process the extracted image to enhance the contrast between the background and the target area can obtain a high-quality electric energy meter picture, and the Canny edge detection algorithm is improved by the OTSU algorithm to improve the adaptability of the image threshold range to obtain a more complete image appearance outline. Character segmentation processing to obtain the rated parameter information of the electric energy meter. According to the regulations of OIML and NE standards, through analysis and demonstration, an optimized solution for fast inspection of electric energy meter constants that not only meets the inspection error requirements specified in the standard but also shortens the test time is proposed.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Pseudo-information Detection Technology Based on Computer Information Hiding
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the development and popularity of the Internet, the network has become one of the most important ways for people to access various resources. However, the open, shared and free nature of the Internet makes it convenient for users and also brings many security issues. How to ensure that data transmission is not illegally intercepted or tampered with and that sensitive information can be effectively protected has become an urgent problem. At present, there are two main solutions to this problem: one is to prevent data theft through encryption; the other is to use digital watermarking technology to embed secret information into the carrier, thus achieving covert communication. Either way has some drawbacks: the encryption algorithm is too complex and requires a large amount of computation, which is not suitable for real-time processing; although the digital watermarking technology can well resist the attacks of malicious attackers, its concealment capability is limited and cannot meet the needs of certain special fields. Therefore, this paper proposes a new scheme combining encryption algorithm and digital watermarking technology - a pseudo information detection technique based on computer information hiding. The technique uses the principle of cryptography to design a complete key management system, thus ensuring the safe and reliable operation of the whole system. The digital signature technology is used to generate random numbers as the watermark signal after pre-processing the original file, and then the watermark signal is sent to the receiver together with the original file, and finally the watermark signal is extracted to complete the verification work of the original file. The experimental results show that CIHD not only improves embedding efficiency and reduces embedding cost compared with traditional information hiding techniques, but also enhances anti-attack capability.

articleTitle: Application of a Deep Generative Model for Diversified Video Subtitles Based on Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the continuous development of artificial intelligence, cross-field applications in image recognition, natural language processing, and semantic recognition have gradually emerged. Video subtitle generation is one of the typical cross-field application scenarios. By recognizing image semantics and using natural language for generative content construction, users can often understand the content of images intuitively and quickly. In addition, when the contents are displayed in text form, it is convenient for textual retrieval or other text-based image applications. This paper proposes the application of generative adversarial networks in subtitle recognition. By focusing more on generation diversity, the degree of the differentiated description of generated content can be further improved, making image and video subtitles generation content prone to human habits. Specifically, the idea is to use the generative adversarial network to generate the subtitles of the images in the video and use diversified generative models to conduct difference optimization to obtain better generative performance. It is hoped that the research in this paper can help the application of diversified video subtitles generation.

articleTitle: Research on Communication Technology Security System Based on Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In this paper, the principle of beam forming and its shortcomings are briefly introduced based on the introduction of direction modulation technology. Then this paper focuses on the computer artificial intelligence technology on the premise of large-scale antenna array based on antenna subset selection and hybrid array direction modulation technology to achieve the safe transmission target method. The improvement of safety performance is explained from the theoretical point of view. Again, this paper takes the virtual machine monitor as the foothold of security protection to make full use of the virtual machine monitor interception, isolation, I/O data encryption and decryption mechanism to build a new information system security protection framework. The simulation results show that this mechanism can effectively improve the security in the collaborative environment of 5G mobile communication system.

articleTitle: Image Recognition and Diagnosis System of Early Gastric Cancer Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the improvement of people's attention to their own health, a large quantity of tumor-related medical data are generated in parallel every day. Artificial intelligence (AI) can summarize and analyze a large quantity of tumor-related data to help doctors work efficiently. Narrow-band imaging (NbI) technology is a brand-new endoscopic imaging technology, which has the function of electronic staining and can highlight the capillary network in the superficial mucosa. Combined with magnifying technology, the fine structure of the superficial mucosa can be displayed more clearly. In this article, an early gastric cancer image recognition algorithm based on convolutional neural network (CNN) is proposed, which provides support for the construction of early gastric cancer image recognition and diagnosis system. Using the collected image data, the quantity of samples is increased through data enhancement on a few data sets, and the precision, recall and error of various models are compared. The results show that the accuracy and recall rate of this algorithm are higher than those of traditional methods, and the recognition error of cancer image in this paper is significantly lower. The model has high accuracy, specificity and sensitivity in the diagnosis of early gastric cancer, and can assist endoscopists in real-time diagnosis during gastroscopy.

articleTitle: Design of Portable Fruit Impedance Spectrum Measuring System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper designs a portable fruit impedance spectrum measurement system, which is specially designed for fruit maturity evaluation in fruit picking, transportation and customer selection. Its design uses conductive materials for contact-type non-destructive measurement, uses AD5933 to collect the impedance distribution of the measured fruit at each frequency band from 10KHZ to 100KHZ, draws the impedance spectrum of the fruit, and displays the measurement results in an intuitive way on the Android APP on the mobile phone. In the process of the experiment, the impedance spectrum of the passive components is collected. The test results are compared with the performance of the desktop impedance analyzer under the same measurement conditions. The relative error of the measured values are less than 3.8%. Finally, we give an example of the application of this design in the impedance spectrum measurement of green mango fruit.

articleTitle: An Improved Min-Sum Polar Code Decoding Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In 2009, the presentation of polar code, the first theory to approach the Shannon limit of communication channel coding schemes. Thus, academics and business have focused on Polar codes. Research and worldwide standards have been offered one after another, establishing the groundwork for its real-world use.The paper proposes a min-sum decoding technique for enhanced Polar codes and revises the node update formula in the min-sum decoding algorithm by using the piecewise linear function to approximate the function ln cosh(x) in the belief propagation decoding algorithm. Compared to the min-sum decoding algorithm, the enhanced approach improves decoding performance while somewhat increasing complexity. Compared to the belief propagation decoding algorithm, this approach decreases computational complexity significantly and is simpler to implement in hardware. Based on the min-sum method and the belief propagation algorithm, this approach is offered as a balance between complexity and performance. The simulation results demonstrate that the enhanced min-sum decoding algorithm performs similarly to its predecessor. The performance of the degree propagation decoding method is almost identical to that of the min-sum decoding technique, which is superior.

articleTitle: APTTOOLNER: A Chinese Dataset of Cyber Security Tool for NER Task
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The existing named entity recognition work in cyber security focuses on the threat intelligence field, and two problems appeared: 1) The language for NER datasets in threat intelligence mainly is in English. 2) The definition of named entities in the field of threat intelligence is confusing. For these two issues, we collected 244 APT analysis reports and analyzed the flow of threat intelligence, then predefined 7 APT tool related (which is the base of threat intelligence) entities. Two experts labeled the reports twice for consistent understanding. Finally, we got a dataset for APT tool entity in Chinese with 31423 predefined entity tags and 424930 O tags, and the dataset was validated on a regular NER model.

articleTitle: Research on Relay Protection Fault Handling Method in Automatic Communication Network of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper proposes a high reliability relay protection configuration and setting scheme for distribution network. The system includes protection configuration, value setting method and protection cooperation. The outlet circuit breaker and the contact switch in the substation are equipped with current limiting protection devices in case of inter-phase short-circuit fault, the outlet circuit breaker current limiting protection devices can limit the current quickly. If the fault is permanent, a current limiting protection device can be configured on the contact switch to isolate the faulty area and restore power supply to the healthy area under current limiting conditions. The simulation results show that the proposed protection configuration scheme can improve the rapidity, selectivity and power supply reliability of distribution network protection. The algorithm has wide applicability and high application value.

articleTitle: Research on unsupervised MDS technology based on graph structure
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: At present, most text summary methods based on deep learning are supervised methods that require large dataset. However, large-scale multi-document summary(MDS) datasets are difficult to obtain in practical applications. This paper proposes an unsupervised MDS extraction method based on graph structure. First, we use a pre-trained language model based on BERT for sentence representation. Secondly, according to the semantic relation between sentences, the semantic relation graph of sentences is constructed. Then the centroid and maximum marginal correlation algorithm (MMR) were used to remove the redundancy of candidate summary. Finally, experiments are conducted on a Multi-news dataset to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper achieves better results in the unsupervised domain and is comparable with some supervised models. The method proposed in this paper has wide application prospects in the field of multi-document sentiment summarization.

articleTitle: High-level optimization of industrial big data of DCC device based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The use of industrial big data high-level optimization to diagnose and analyze DCC devices has been applied in the petrochemical production process, promoting the revolutionary breakthrough of production process control. Combined with the company’s idea of enhancing its core competitiveness through information technology, it then elaborates the existing data modeling methods, builds a software model, and tries to optimize its process big data and models through neural network algorithms to improve the potential of process control, so as to achieve the purpose of reducing costs and increasing efficiency. Finally, the characteristics of high-level optimization of industrial big data and the problems and challenges that may be faced in the process of realizing this are discussed, in order to achieve a breakthrough in the company’s overall business value.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Target Tracking and Localization Algorithm Based on Computer Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Target tracking and positioning of UAV is an important part of UAV intelligence. Its main purpose is to achieve accurate tracking of target position, speed and attitude, and timely acquisition of target motion information in the process of movement. Based on the analysis and research of UAV trajectory and flight path characteristics, the traditional UAV motion parameter estimation method has many problems and shortcomings, and a UAV motion parameter estimation algorithm based on multi-sensor information fusion technology is established. This method realizes the estimation of target position and speed by the tracking system based on multi-source sensor information fusion technology. It can effectively solve the problems such as low accuracy of traditional inertial navigation system and difficult to achieve accurate target positioning in complex environment, which can improve the target positioning accuracy and lay the foundation for the intelligent control of UAV.

articleTitle: Research on Security System of Computer Network Big Data Encryption System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper designs and implements a digital content security protection system based on transparent encryption and decryption technology for enterprise electronic documents and digital content security protection requirements. Based on the original file system filtering driven encryption system, an enhanced file encryption system is proposed, which includes authentication, eKey module, hierarchical protection and key management. At the same time, this paper establishes the entity and identity two-level authentication mechanism. The system implements multi-level file key and key access control. The file protection system Decrypts uses a custom TPM key management module. This system improves the key management part of crypts user space. The overall system security is further enhanced by eliminating the multi-user mode. Through the experiment test, it is found that the system encryption is good.

articleTitle: Speech Recognition System of Specific Vocabulary
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: End-to-end speech recognition system can realize the conversion from input audio to character text without complicated data processing, and it is widely used in speech recognition field. In this paper, the speech recognition system of DeepSpeech2 is built by combining CNN network which is good at capturing sequence spatial features and RNN network which is good at capturing time sequence information. The system is trained based on the THCHS-30 Dataset, and achieves more accurate speech prediction by simplifying the process and enhancing the use of context information. Experiments based on this dataset show that the word error rate of this model is only 0.133, and the effect is very ideal.

articleTitle: Research on Bearings-only Passive Location Based on UAV Formation Flight
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of UAV positioning, this paper firstly distributes the formation UAVs evenly on the circumference, and the numbers of the UAVs transmitting signals are known and there is no deviation in their positions, so that the positions of three UAVs transmitting signals on the circumference can be determined. The polar coordinate system is established to solve the problem. In each case, the simultaneous equations are listed according to the sine theorem of the triangle, and finally the positioning model of the UAV receiving the signal can be established. Next, the triangulation positioning method is adopted, and three of the four emitting points are randomly selected for triangulation positioning. Finally, it is found that there is a positional relationship between the emitting points with unknown numbers. Four positioning circles are calculated by the least square method, and the intersection of any two positioning circles is the position of the receiving point. Finally, through computer simulation, the above modeling is simulated and the error curve is calculated, and an optimal adjustment scheme of UAV is obtained.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Edge System Based on Artificial Intelligence Reasoning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: To meet the challenges of reliable connections and low latency, researchers adopt edge computing to process IoT data by distributing a large number of edge servers close to IoT devices to process requests from these devices and then route them to the core The internet. We proposed a distributed edge system method based on intelligent reasoning is obtained by encoding the state of context-aware information fusion and the resource allocation scheme, and modeling the resource adjustment allocated for the service as a federated learning method under the framework of the Deep Q Network. An effective resource allocation strategy model dynamically generates an appropriate resource allocation plan through the system state to maximize the credibility gain of the service. Experimental results show that this method based on edge devices has better accuracy and response speed.

articleTitle: Research on the identification of Tibetan herbal medicine based on STM-A Net
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In order to implement the accurate, non-destructive, and fast classification of Tibetan medicinal materials, taking the current images of various Tibetan medicinal materials as the research object, an STM-Attention module of plug-and-play is proposed based on deep learning. In this paper, the STM-Attention modules are stacked according to the ResNet method, forming a new classification backbone network structure-STM-A Net. At the same time, the network has the advantages of small parameters and computation, and can better extract features under the condition of ensuring speed. Experimental results show that under the same conditions, the network achieves a balance between parameter quantity and accuracy, and the accuracy rate reaches 97.18% on the test set of Tibetan medicinal materials.

articleTitle: Lung Nodule Segmentation Method Based on 3D Rem-Unet
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: For the problems of inaccurate positioning and imprecise edge segmentation of lung nodules in 3D medical computed tomography (CT) images, a 3D Rem-UNet method for lung nodule segmentation is proposed. Using 3D UNet as the reference model, a multi-branch hybrid attention (MHA) module is added to the encoder structure to improve the extraction of detailed features in the target region; The residual connection is used to realize feature reuse; And the Group Normalization (GN) algorithm is introduced to achieve the feature normalization. Finally, ablation experiments are conducted on the LUNA16 dataset to verify the effectiveness of the model. The experimental results show that 3D Rem-UNet has the fastest loss convergence and the most stable loss change during the training process. Meanwhile, compared with 3D UNet model, the dice coefficient, accuracy, recall and F1 score are increased by 4.73%, 14.6%, 1.76% and 4.71%, respectively. The model can effectively improve the segmentation effect of lung nodules.

articleTitle: FPGA-based Convolutional Neural Network Design and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Deep convolutional neural networks have prominent advantages in fields like image identification and natural language processing, but because of their high storage costs and massive computational volumes, they are frequently widely used in servers with GPU acceleration capability. As autonomous driving, aerospace, and other industries evolve, some scenarios have higher requirements for real-time detection than others. Since it is not feasible to search for targets by sending video streams to the server for inference and then returning the results, low-power hardware acceleration options for neural networks must be investigated. In this paper, we suggest an FPGA-based specialized accelerator for convolutional neural networks. To support the parallel execution of each convolution module, we analyze the computational properties of neural networks and design a convolutional computational structure with the deep flow and high parallelism. In addition, each layer of convolution is internally divided into multiple computational units along the channel direction to further enhance the computational parallelism. In this study, we use the Xilinx xc7z100 platform to implement an onboard test for a yolov5s-based neural network. According to the experimental findings, this design structure's acceleration ratio can reach 142 times and its power consumption is only 4.5W, which could provide a significant performance boost at a low power consumption when compared to the 800MHz ARM cortexA9.

articleTitle: Research on Seismic Signal Recognition and Prejudgment Based on Deep Learning Model CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Traditional seismic signal detection algorithms mainly use micro-seismic signal sensors to capture seismic signal waves. In this way, the corresponding parameters and specific information of the seismic source can be obtained. However, this method has its potential disadvantages, mainly due to the harmonic noise under the micro-sensor collected during the earthquake being too large. Moreover, the sensor’s monitoring environment in the automatic signal transmission is often very harsh. Therefore, the signal-to-noise ratio of the acquired data information is extremely low, which causes the problem that microseismic events are difficult to identify. This paper uses an improved deep learning convolutional neural network model to innovate the traditional seismic signal recognition process algorithm to deal with the above problems. Focus on improving the accuracy and reliability of seismic signal identification using sensors by optimizing the processes and steps of seismic signal identification and judgment.

articleTitle: Study on Relationship between ATC Controller Workload and Sector Capacity
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Based on Wickens' information processing and cognitive model, the relationship between attention resources and control workload is constructed. Firstly, the controller load model is briefly introduced; Then, the controller's attention loss model is described; Finally, the relationship between control communication load and sector capacity is discussed in depth. Through numerical simulation, the evolution rules of attention resources and residual workload of controllers are verified.

articleTitle: New Feature Selection Method and Its Applications on Prediction of Hot Metal Silicon Content in Blast Furnace
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In the related studies of data-driven models for predicting hot metal silicon content in blast furnace, the prediction accuracies are always depended on the feature selection methods. In this paper, a novel feature selection method based on rough set is thus proposed. First, we suggests the notion of attribute distance to analyze the differences between samples to avoid the discerning marginal problem On this basis, a new discernible matrix and the related attribute reduction algorithm are proposed. Next, we trained the hot metal silicon content prediction models based on deep learning and compared the proposed algorithm with the traditional algorithms based on the Rough set, Pearson correlation coefficient, and Grey correlation coefficient. These experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on SOC Estimation Algorithm and Battery Health Diagnosis and Monitoring System for Automotive Power Battery
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In this paper, the battery management system of a hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) is analyzed and studied. A vehicle battery management system suitable for PHEV is designed. The dynamic estimation of SOC, the processing mode of signal, the wake up and exit process of BMS and the auxiliary contact detection of relay are studied. Based on the theory of multiple time scales, the operating state and life of on-board battery are considered comprehensively, and the changes of SOC and SOH in dynamic operation of lithium-ion battery are predicted accurately, so that lithium-ion battery can be recycled more effectively in the process of vehicle development.

articleTitle: Research on Facial Expression Recognition Model Based on ResNet Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Facial expression recognition is a research hot spot in computer vision, which can be widely used in automatic driving, online classroom, social networking and other aspects. In view of the problems of the convolutional neural network in facial expression recognition, such as large computer complexity, large input size and insufficient local feature extraction, a network model based on the improved ResNet network is built by using Center-Loss function to improve the ResNet network, improve feature extraction ability of the model and the accuracy of model recognition. Experiments show that there are some improvements in FER2013 and CK+ expression data sets.

articleTitle: Application Research of Large Data Wireless Transmission System in Computer Information System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The author proposes a system design scheme and implementation based on ZigBee wireless sensor network and GPRS network, which integrates data acquisition and transmission. This system uses the Internet access function of GPRS. It uses the RS-232 interface to read external data. The hardware system uses the Rabbit2000 microprocessor and PIML-900/1800GPRS module. The above modules build a real-time and reliable application system, software includes operating system, acquisition terminal software and control center server software. The simulation results show that this method can reduce the bit error rate and improve the quality of wireless multimedia transmission.

articleTitle: Acoustic Signal Denoising Technology Investigation of Hydroelectric Generator Based on Wavelet Threshold
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that hydroelectric generator sound signal detection is prone to external interference, this paper proposes a noise denoising method of hydroelectric generator sound signal based on wavelet threshold based on the analysis of time-frequency domain characteristics of hydroelectric generator sound signal, and uses autocorrelation analysis to extract acoustic signal characteristic frequency, and verifies the effectiveness of the algorithm through simulation tests. The algorithm is applied to the noise reduction analysis of the hydroelectric generator signal measured in the field. The results show that the wavelet threshold denoising method can effectively remove the Gaussian white noise signal in the hydroelectric generator sound signal and improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the hydroelectric generator sound signal. The autocorrelation analysis can further reduce the impact of noise and extract the key characteristic frequencies of sound signals of hydroelectric generators. The research results have reference significance for improving the sound measurement accuracy of hydroelectric generators under complex environmental interference conditions.

articleTitle: Realization of Topology Matching Algorithm for Space Node Network of Intelligent Building Platform Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the development of the Internet and delivery services, online exchange services have become more and more convenient and popular. The application of publishing/smart reading systems in the field of exchange services has changed the way people deal with information. The rapid development of emerging technologies such as the Internet of Things, virtual reality, and artificial intelligence, the continuous improvement of cloud computing and big data infrastructure, the rapid development of the building intelligence industry, and the development of building automation systems. The control algorithm in the new building intelligent platform has the characteristics of no center and distribution. At this stage, the engineering application test of the algorithm is difficult and there is a risk of damaging electromechanical equipment. It is necessary to build a simulation model combined with the new building intelligent simulation platform in the new building intelligent platform for simulation test and verification. In order to achieve the goal of building a sustainable development society, green buildings are widely popular because of their low energy consumption, people-oriented, local conditions and environment-friendly characteristics. The replica placement strategy for the new building intelligent platform performs better in load balancing than the default replica placement strategy; The replica selection strategy for the new building intelligent platform has higher user access efficiency than the default replica selection strategy. Experiments verify the effectiveness of the two strategies.

articleTitle: A Study of Visual Question Answering Techniques Based on Collaborative Multi-Head Attention
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In visual question answering task, the dominant approach recently has been to use a unified model for pre- training and fine tuning it. This unified model typically uses a transformer to fuse image and text information. In order to optimize the performance of the model on visual question answering task, this paper proposes a transformer architecture based on a collaborative multi-head attention mechanism to address the key/value projection redundancy problem in the multi-head attention mechanism of the transformer. In addition, this paper uses the Swin transformer model as the image feature extractor to extract multi-scale image information. Validation experiments are conducted on the VQA v2 dataset in this paper, and the experimental results show that applying the collaborative multi-head attention approach and the Swin transformer backbone to the visual question answering model can effectively improve the correct rate of the visual question answering task.

articleTitle: A Fast DSSS Signal Acquisition Method with Low Computing Load Based on Approximate Kernel FFT/IFFT
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper presents a fast Direct Sequence Spread Spectrum (DSSS) signal acquisition method based on the approximate kernel FFT/IFFT in order to realize both fast acquisition and low computing load when receiving signal have a large Doppler frequency. Through substituting an approximate kernel function for the FFT/IFFT kernel function in the classic FFT/IFFT acquisition method to simplify multiplication operations into addition, this method can provide fast acquisition on the low computation basis while maintaining high acquisition performance. The simulation results verify that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Wearable Devices for the Elderly Based on ARM
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of not being able to take care of the elderly living alone at home in different places and not being able to timely understand their physical condition, this paper presents the design of a Intelligent wearable watch based on ARM. The device uses WiFi&BLE wireless communication module, oxygen sensor and heart rate, automatic voice recognition (ASR) technology module, gyroscope module, and RSSI technology. The device periodically detects some physiological parameters of the wearing site, and pushes them to the children's mobile phone through the WeChat public account periodically, so as to grasp the physical health status of parents remotely. The device automatically identifies the elderly who fall through the result algorithm of the gyroscope module, and timely reminds the children through the WeChat official account. The device has functions such as sleep monitoring, electronic fence, and fall detection, which facilitates the elderly and their families to pay attention to the health status of the elderly in a multidimensional way, and provides convenience for the elderly to live a high-quality life in their later years.

articleTitle: Research on System Application of Network Wireless Transmission Technology Based on Computer SDN
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper first introduces the use of SDN technology to realize the bidirectional network structure of NGB-W. And the function of each level is analyzed in detail. On this basis, it is proposed to use OpenFlow technology to manage SDN in the bidirectional network of NGB-W. On this basis, a wireless communication system using SDN technology to realize DDoS protection is introduced. Finally, the simulation platform of the fusion network is established by using NS-3 simulation software. The article compares and evaluates the simulation results in various cases. Through simulation verification, the method proposed in this paper can effectively reduce and improve network congestion, reduce network delay, and improve saturated throughput.

articleTitle: Study of Highly Educated Women's Dating Willingness Based on XGboost and CART Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The willingness of highly educated women to choose a mate is discussed. First, based on the "one-to-one matching" mode of a well-known marriage platform in China, the training data set and test data set are constructed. Secondly, based on the CART decision tree algorithm, an interpretable model of the female's willingness to choose a mate with high education is constructed, which outputs the common characteristics of the female's willingness to choose a mate and the characteristics of the most popular male group. Then, based on the XGBoost algorithm, an inexplicable model of women with high academic qualifications' willingness to choose a mate is constructed, and a set of intelligent recommendation strategies is proposed, which can provide personalized member recommendation results according to the needs of different female members. The experimental results on the test data set show that the F1-Score of CART decision tree model is 78.1%, and the F1-Score of XGBoost model is 85.2%. The actual test results show that the success rate of the intelligent recommendation strategy is significantly higher than the manual recommendation of the matchmaker.

articleTitle: A Study of Instrument Playing Action Recommendation Scheme with AI Vision Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: To address the problem of low accuracy rate of musical instrument playing movements with AI vision technology at this stage, we propose to build a logical statistical model of musical instrument playing movements using improved particle swarm algorithm to collect data and pinpoint simple human movements. The model is implemented based on a certain sports bracelet to recognize the basic playing movements. Firstly, the support vector machine (SVM) model is optimized by improved particle swarm optimization (IPSO) algorithm and structured local dictionary learning, and then the optimized SVM is used to classify the human activity detection data. And the error information is corrected by using scenario analysis method. The results demonstrate that the accuracy rate of performance action information detection can reach 94.3% by applying the model on a sports bracelet, which shows that AI vision technology can achieve accurate pushing of target human performance action solutions by combining with this user portrait model. The creation of complex musical compositions requires the display of true creativity, which depends on various factors related to the hierarchy of musical language. Music generation faces algorithmic problems, and in this paper we want to apply deep learning models based on AI vision techniques to the human music composition and creative process.

articleTitle: Sniper Shooting Environment Detection System Based on 51 Single Chip Microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern military strength, the military's combat ability has encountered unprecedented new situations and problems. It has provided development opportunities and posed severe challenges for military modernization. With the development of science and technology, the combat capability of individual soldiers has become one of the most important factors. Snipers are the key link to accurately attack important enemy targets. The sniper's shooting environment directly affects its combat effectiveness. Therefore, a simple and clear external environment detection device is made. The device detects and displays temperature, humidity, wind speed and atmospheric pressure in real time. The detection device can help the sniper judge the time of firing and improve the sniper's ability to complete accurate sniping on the target. Accurate snipers play a vital role in causing psychological panic and slowing down the enemy's advance speed.

articleTitle: Application research of visualization optimization algorithm of network topology based on simulated annealing algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: People have successfully applied complex network theory to many cross-cutting fields, including social network construction, route planning, and association information mining. For complex networks, the visualization of network topology is one of the main ways to express and convey information. With the help of visualization techniques, users can visually and intuitively perceive the objects and inter-object relationships expressed by the network. However, many complex network visualization algorithms often ignore the user's intuitive cognitive needs for complex networks, making the final generated network visualization results suffer from path intersection and node overlap. This paper proposes a visualization optimization algorithm based on the simulated annealing algorithm oriented to the mainstream force layout algorithm to optimize and design a reasonable optimization function. It adjusts the structures that are unfavorable to visual cognition and improves the cognitive efficiency of users in the visualization of network topology. The author expects that the research in this paper will be helpful for the optimization of network topology visualization algorithms for complex networks and their applications.

articleTitle: Modeling Test of Excitation System of the 2nd Unit in a Certain Overseas Coal-fired Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The requirements of improving the ability to maintain generator voltage and improving the stability of power system are consistent in many aspects. Field control system plays a significant role in improving static stability, dynamic stability and transient stability, and it is the simplest, economical and effective measure. The results of the stable calculation of the power system can be true and reliable by adopting mathematical models and parameters that can correctly reflect the actual running device operation status. The paper describes the content and process of the modeling test of field system of the 2<sup>nd</sup> Unit in a coal-fired power station along the coast of Southeast Asia, and analyzes and summarizes the test data.

articleTitle: Two-stage mean vector-based competitive representation for image classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Collaborative-competitive representation based classification (CCRC), as a very novel collaborative representation classification method, has achieved good results in the field of image classification. In this paper, in order to enhance the discriminative ability of each class to achieve the improvement of classification performance, we propose a novel collaborative representation (CR) model called the two-stage mean vector-based competitive representation (TMCR) for image classification. The TMCR model introduces a class-specific mean vector constraint and uses a two-stage idea to further improve the classification performance of the model. TMCR divides representation into two stages: coarse representation and fine representation. In the first stage, we select classes in which training samples are similar to the query samples through the mean vector-based competitive representation, and then we use the classes to perform a more correct representation and classification of the query samples in the second stage. In addition, we make full use of the localities of data and introduce weight constraints by calculating the distances between the testing sample and each training sample. The discriminative ability of the model is further improved by the mean vector constraint, the idea of two-stage and weight constraint. Experimental results obtained on GT and ORL datasets indicate that the proposed model can surpass state-of-the-art CR-based methods.

articleTitle: An Optimized LSTM Passenger Flow Prediction Model for Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Research on intelligent transportation systems is essential to the development of smart cities. Although it is frequently challenging for urban transportation planners to forecast urban traffic passenger flow due to the massive population flow and complicated flow patterns in cities, this often results in resource waste in urban building. In order to better use resources, this paper proposes the use of machine learning methods to predict the passenger flow of urban subway systems, to help relevant agencies make more rational urban transportation planning. Using a user passenger flow data set of a subway station system, To forecast the number of people using subway stations, LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) neural networks, random forests, and gradient boosting tree models are created. Model performance testing is done using MAE and MSE to compare how well the three models perform on this task. The experimental findings demonstrate that the LSTM approach outperforms alternative models.

articleTitle: Design of Target Missile Safety Control System Based on Active Passive Composite System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: To ensure the safety of participating ships and protected targets in the air defense weapon test, embedded architecture and multi-channel control technology is adopted, and aiming at advanced, practical, reliable and low cost, a compound target missile security control system is developed, which integrates autonomous position over boundary security control, altitude over high security control, attitude over bias security control, time over time security control. The three-level thermal backup security control strategy is proposed under normal, security guide interfered and security control computer failure. The binding polygon model of the safety control area and the five-part self-destruct counter scheme were constructed. The safety control trajectory of the range channel jumping to dive avoidance and the heading channel side avoidance were designed, which realized the safety control of the target projectile and the function of preventing the wrong destruction, and solved the safety problem of the launching ship in the small route test of air defense weapons.

articleTitle: Study on the optimization algorithm of polar line correction based on feature extraction and Gaussian filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Aiming at various common problems in the process of calculating polar line correction in the matching direction of binocular stereo vision, this paper proposes a polar line correction algorithm based on gray-scale change threshold feature extraction and Gaussian filtering to filter out noise points. In binocular stereo vision, the feature point matching problem of stereo images has always been its core. In this paper, after extracting the feature points with the reference of Gluckman's method and Francesco's method, we use the improved normalized eight-point algorithm to solve the base matrix and reject the mis-matching points with RANSAC algorithm, so as to avoid the non-parallelism between the polar lines caused by the external influence such as assembly, i.e., the vertical parallax of the corresponding feature points during binocular measurement. The image is then transformed by projection, so that the images correspond to the same scan line, thus satisfying the scanning characteristics.

articleTitle: A lifting contrastive learning method for rotating machinery fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The datasets in the field of machinery fault diagnostics typically contain a significant number of unlabeled data alongside a small amount of labeled data, and there are category imbalances, which all lead to low fault diagnosis accuracy. To cope with this issue, a lifting contrastive learning method for rotating machinery fault diagnosis is proposed. First, the SE-ResNet50-based contrastive learning network is self-supervised trained using all data in the dataset (including labeled and unlabeled data). Second, to address the effect of category imbalance on the classifier, Focal Loss is added to the downstream task. When compared to prior methods for planetary gearbox fault diagnosis, experimental results show that the proposed method achieves higher diagnostic accuracy in limited and imbalanced labeling situations.

articleTitle: Video Emotional Classification Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: We perform video emotion classification based on deep reinforcement learning, simulate the process of a human watching video and getting the emotional expression, and find a way to combine reinforcement learning algorithms with video emotion analysis characters. The Conv-LSTM network is built as an agent in the critical model, and the LSTM network is trained in combination with the A3C algorithm in reinforcement learning, which makes the model have emotion recognition ability and verifies the effectiveness on single and compound emotion datasets.

articleTitle: Scheduling Synergies Between Berth and Yard in Bulk Ports Based on MOPSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Scheduling is the essential component of the contemporary port operation system. Recently, as the quantity and types of ships and bulk entering the port increase, the precision of manual scheduling decreases, resulting in illogical berth and yard selection and inefficient resource usage. The intelligent scheduling plan can arrange all resources more precisely, increasing the port’s operating efficiency and economic benefits. Therefore, we constructed a multi-objective collaborative scheduling optimization model with the time of ships in the port, the distance of transport machinery, and the penalty cost of delay as the optimization objectives, under the premise of comprehensive consideration of berths and yards. Moreover, we proposed an intelligent scheduling method to optimize it with the improved MOPSO algorithm. Finally, with using the real historical data of bulk cargo ports, the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed model and method were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Design of tobacco industry hierarchical early warning system based on big data
